$comment: TransLink's GTFS feeds (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#source-data). Which routes are drawn: routes.json. Regions showing it: metro-vancouver.
name: TransLink

static.$comment: The undated zip is the latest feed and serves the same file as its dated History/ snapshot (fetched daily: not part of the Open API budget).

realtime.$comment: TransLink's GTFS-realtime (buses only: no SkyTrain, SeaBus or West Coast Express), polled by the server's leader only (apps/server/README.md#real-time-service). The key (TRANSLINK_API_KEY, in the environment or .secrets) never leaves the server.
realtime.$poll: TransLink's Open API terms allow an API key 'a maximum of 1,000 requests per day' (https://www.translink.ca/about-us/doing-business-with-translink/app-developer-resources/terms-of-use, checked 2026-09-29; unclear whether that covers GTFS-RT). Until TransLink says otherwise, the leader stays under dailyCap across all three feeds in any 24 hours (a ledger in var/rt-history/requests.json enforces it across restarts), polling most often at peak. Bands (local time) are guesses at when buses are busiest; at most ~970 in any 24 hours (~965 on a weekday, ~815 on a weekend day) (packages/transit-core/src/rt/budget.ts, test/rt-budget.test.ts). Holidays run the weekday schedule. SkyTrain alerts with a recognised operating change become draft disruptions (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#disruptions-and-alerts), so alertsS delays drafts by up to that long. OPEN-QUESTIONS #29.
realtime.$staleGraceS: Clients treat live data as unavailable (and fall back to schedule estimates) once it's this much older than the positions poll interval. Was 120 s at a fixed 20 s interval.
realtime.$coverageSlackS: Recorder coverage breaks when consecutive snapshots are further apart than the positions poll interval plus this. Was 75 s at a fixed 20 s interval.
realtime.$interpolateSlackS: Interpolate a vehicle between two observations only when they are at most the positions poll interval plus this apart. Was 180 s at a fixed 20 s interval.
realtime.$extrapolateSlackS: At the live edge, predict a vehicle forward along its route for at most the positions poll interval plus this (fixes are already ~20-60 s old when fetched). Was 90 s at a fixed 20 s interval.
realtime.$tripUpdatesMinCoverage: /healthz fails when fewer than this share of the vehicles in a positions poll (those on a trip) have a delay from TransLink's trip updates: the trip-updates feed is empty or no longer matches the positions. Measured 2026-10-01 to 10-11: 75-85 % in service hours, 36-60 % at night; 0 from 04:00 on 2026-10-12 while polls kept succeeding (apps/server/README.md#real-time-service). Guess at the threshold.
